what_it_does: Page Industries Limited manufactures, distributes, and markets premium innerwear, athleisure, and swimwear. Holding exclusive licenses for Jockey and Speedo, the company sells its products through retail networks and digital platforms, generating revenue from garment sales.

segments.name: Manufacture of textile garments and clothing accessories

other_facts: The company operates 16 manufacturing units with a production capacity of 280 million pieces per year.
Exports account for less than 1% of the total turnover.
The retail network includes 1,615+ Exclusive Brand Stores (EBS).
